SELECT title, author, price
FROM book b1
WHERE price > (
    SELECT AVG(price)
    FROM book b2
    WHERE b2.author = b1.author
);

SELECT author, AVG(price) as avg_price
FROM book
GROUP BY author
HAVING AVG(price) > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM book);

SELECT author, COUNT(*) as book_count
FROM book
GROUP BY author
HAVING COUNT(*) > (
    SELECT AVG(book_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) as book_count
        FROM book
        GROUP BY author
    ) as author_book_counts
);
